review.evidence: Read report.py in full and verified its two hard claims independently. (1) Verdict parity: is_blocked/exit_code replicate StageRunResult.blocked()/exit_code() exactly; the characterization test uses StageRunResult itself as ground truth and enumerates FINDINGS and 'bogus'. (2) Dead-code check: no caller in src/ — the module is additive and wires nothing, so it cannot change any live verdict. Found one latent divergence: report.normalize_decision omits the runner's FINDINGS->FAIL branch, so FINDINGS reads as ERROR. Traced gate_runner.py:412 as the only path where an executor decision enters gates[]; it normalizes there, so a raw FINDINGS can never reach the report from the runner. Verified by direct call that both spellings are non-PASS, hence is_blocked and exit_code are identical either way — the divergence mislabels a decision in the detail file but changes no verdict. Recorded as a follow-up, not a blocker.
